title: Triple passage: Press release, article, and online comment
passage:
【Document 1: Press release】
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE — April 3
Greenway Foods to Open Its First Store in Riverton
Greenway Foods, a regional grocery chain known for its locally grown produce, will open a 2,000-square-meter store on Elm Avenue on May 15. The store will create approximately 60 jobs and will feature a café, a bakery, and a weekend farmers' market in its parking lot. Hiring events will be held at the Riverton Community Center on April 12 and 19. The store will offer more than 3,000 products, with a focus on produce from farms within 100 kilometers of Riverton. Greenway Foods was founded in 1998 and currently operates 14 stores in neighboring counties. Store hours will be 7:00 A.M. to 10:00 P.M. daily. "We are proud to bring fresh, local food to Riverton," said company president David Greenway. Greenway Foods will also donate unsold bread to local food banks at the end of each day, and it plans to expand its bakery team later this year. The company also plans a community event this summer with local musicians, which will be announced later. A delivery service for customers within the city will begin at the Riverton store in June.

【Document 2: Article】
Riverton Daily — May 16
Crowds Greet New Grocery Store
Hundreds of shoppers lined up outside the new Greenway Foods store on Elm Avenue yesterday morning. Store manager Elena Petrov said the company had hired 72 local residents, more than originally planned, because of strong interest at its hiring events. The weekend farmers' market, however, will not begin until June because several vendors needed more time to prepare. Some nearby residents have expressed concern about increased traffic on Elm Avenue. The city council will review a request for a new traffic light at the Elm Avenue intersection next month. Shoppers also praised the wide selection of organic products and the friendly staff, and Ms. Petrov said the store may extend its hours if demand continues. Store manager Elena Petrov also noted that the bakery has been busy since the first morning, and the produce section is restocked twice a day. The store also installed electric vehicle charging stations in its parking lot, although only four are currently available. Several shoppers said they would return once the farmers' market opens.

【Document 3: Online comment】
Posted by Tom W., May 17
I visited Greenway on its first day. The produce section is excellent, and the bakery sells the best bread in town. My only complaint is the parking lot, which was completely full when I arrived. I ended up parking on a side street. Once the farmers' market starts in the same lot, I expect parking will be even harder on weekends. The cashiers were quick, and I was in and out in fifteen minutes. I will definitely return, although I would arrive early on weekends. The staff were friendly, and the coffee was excellent. Next time I will try the weekend bread, which I heard sells out quickly. Overall, I would recommend Greenway to anyone living nearby, and I hope management solves the parking problem soon.

【文書1:プレスリリース】4月3日/グリーンウェイ・フーズがリバートンに初出店/地元産の農産物で知られる地域のスーパーチェーンであるグリーンウェイ・フーズは、5月15日にエルム通りに2,000平方メートルの店舗を開店する。約60人の雇用を生み、カフェ、ベーカリー、駐車場での週末のファーマーズマーケットを備える。採用説明会は4月12日と19日にリバートン・コミュニティセンターで開催。店では3,000点以上の商品を扱い、リバートンから100キロメートル以内の農場で採れた農産物に力を入れる。グリーンウェイ・フーズは1998年に創業し、現在は近隣の郡に14店舗を展開している。営業時間は毎日午前7時から午後10時まで。「地元の新鮮な食品をリバートンに届けられることを誇りに思う」と、社長のデイビッド・グリーンウェイは語った。また、売れ残りのパンは毎日閉店後に地元のフードバンクへ寄付され、今年後半にはベーカリーのチームも拡大する予定だ。夏には地元の音楽家を招いた地域イベントも計画しており、詳細は後日発表される。市内の顧客向けの配達サービスは6月からリバートン店で始まる。

【文書2:記事】5月16日/新しいスーパーを群衆が歓迎/昨日の朝、何百人もの買い物客がエルム通りの新しいグリーンウェイ・フーズの前に並んだ。店長のエレナ・ペトロフによると、採用説明会での関心が高かったため、当初の計画より多い72人の地元住民を雇った。ただし週末のファーマーズマーケットは、いくつかの出店者の準備に時間がかかるため6月まで始まらない。近隣住民の中にはエルム通りの交通量の増加を懸念する声もある。市議会は来月、エルム通りの交差点に新しい信号機を設置する要望を検討する予定だ。買い物客からは有機食品の品ぞろえの豊富さや店員の親切さも好評だった。ペトロフ店長は、需要が続けば営業時間を延長するかもしれないと話した。ペトロフ店長はまた、ベーカリーは初日の朝から忙しく、青果売り場は1日2回補充していると説明した。店の駐車場には電気自動車の充電器も設置されたが、現在使えるのは4か所だけだ。ファーマーズマーケットが始まったら戻ってくると話す買い物客も何人かいた。

【文書3:オンラインコメント】初日に行った。青果売り場は素晴らしく、ベーカリーのパンは町で一番。唯一の不満は駐車場で、着いたときには満車だった。結局脇道に停めた。同じ駐車場でファーマーズマーケットが始まれば、週末の駐車はさらに難しくなると思う。レジは速く、15分で買い物を終えられた。また必ず来たいが、週末は早めに来るつもりだ。店員は親切で、コーヒーもおいしかった。次は週末のパンを試したい。週末のパンはすぐ売り切れると聞いた。近所の人にはグリーンウェイを勧めたいが、駐車場の問題は早く解決してほしい。

title: Triple passage: Memo, floor plan, and e-mail about an office renovation
passage:
【Document 1: Memo】
To: All staff, Fenwick Design Studio
From: Rachel Kim, Office Manager
Date: February 10
Subject: Third-floor renovation

Renovation work on the third floor will take place from March 3 to March 21. During this period, the design team will move to temporary desks on the second floor, and the third-floor kitchen will be closed. Staff may use the second-floor kitchen instead. Please pack personal items from your desk by February 28. Boxes will be delivered to each team on February 24. The renovation will add new lighting, updated desks, and a larger kitchen on the third floor. Please remove any plants, photographs, or fragile items from your workspace before the boxes arrive, and label each box with your name and team. The front reception desk will remain open throughout the renovation, and building staff will answer questions about access. Thank you for your patience. Each team will receive a labeled storage bin for small items, and the bins must be returned to the supply room by March 25. Staff are welcome to visit the temporary workspace on February 27 to ask questions before the move. The renovation is expected to finish on schedule, and any delays will be announced by e-mail. Please direct any questions about the move to the office manager, who will also confirm the final date for returning empty boxes.

【Document 2: Floor plan】
Second Floor (temporary layout, March 3–21)
Room 201: Accounting
Room 202: Design team (temporary)
Room 203: Meeting room A (book through the online calendar)
Room 204: Kitchen
Room 205: Storage — boxes from the third floor
Room 206: Restrooms (open to all staff). Room 207: Reception and lounge area. Rooms 201 and 203 are shared with other departments and must be booked in advance. Printers for the temporary layout are located next to Room 204, and each room has a whiteboard and wall display. Additional chairs can be requested from the office manager. The second-floor layout will remain in place until March 21, and rooms will return to normal use the following Monday. Shared kitchen appliances on the second floor will be cleaned each evening.

【Document 3: E-mail】
From: Oliver Grant
To: Rachel Kim
Date: February 26
Subject: Renovation question

Hi Rachel,
I have a client presentation scheduled for March 12 in the third-floor meeting room. Since that room will not be available, I would like to move the presentation to the second floor. I tried to book the room there through the online calendar, but it says the room is already reserved that afternoon. The client has already seen our design proposal and expects a full review, so the room must seat eight people and have a working projector. Could you help me find another option? Also, my team still hasn't received the boxes for packing. We have been preparing the slides for two weeks, and if we cannot use the second-floor room, the client may need to visit our downtown office instead. I would also appreciate any advice about the printed handouts, which are stored in our team's locked cabinet on the third floor. Our team has been working on this project for three months, and the client has a strict schedule. If you could reply by Friday, I would be grateful, so I can update the client before the end of the week.
Thanks,
Oliver

title: Notice: Bridge closure and detour
passage:
CITY TRANSPORTATION DEPARTMENT — PUBLIC NOTICE

The Harrow Street Bridge over Miller Creek will be closed to all traffic from November 10 through December 5. Engineers will inspect and repair the steel supports beneath the bridge. The repairs are part of the city's five-year plan to inspect all bridges in the district. Work crews will set up fencing and warning lights at both ends of the bridge on November 8 and 9, so please plan your trips in advance.

Drivers should use the detour along Lake Road and Route 9. Trucks weighing more than ten tons must follow the Route 9 bypass, which is marked with orange signs. Drivers who normally use the bridge to reach the industrial park should allow an extra fifteen minutes for their journey. Bus Route 14 will stop at a temporary station on Lake Road during the closure, and it will run every twenty minutes at peak hours.

Pedestrians and cyclists may continue to cross the creek on the temporary walkway on the north side of the bridge. The walkway is narrow, so please use caution. Children must be accompanied by an adult at all times, and no one should walk on the closed roadway. Cyclists should dismount and walk their bicycles across the walkway.

The bridge is expected to reopen on December 6, weather permitting. Updated signs will be posted at each junction along the detour during the first week of the closure. The city apologizes for any inconvenience caused by the closure and thanks residents for their patience.

For updates, visit www.harrowcity.gov/transport or call 555-0139.
translation:
市交通局 公示

ミラー川に架かるハロー通りの橋は、11月10日から12月5日まで、すべての車両の通行を止めます。技術者が橋の下にある鋼鉄製の支柱の点検と補修を行います。この点検と補修は、市内のすべての橋を点検する5か年計画の一部です。作業員は11月8日と9日に橋の両端にフェンスと警告灯を設置します。事前に外出の計画を立ててください。

ドライバーはレイク通りと9号線を通る迂回路を使ってください。重さ10トンを超えるトラックは、オレンジ色の標識で示された9号線のバイパスを通らなければなりません。普段この橋を使って工業団地へ向かうドライバーは、移動に15分余分に時間を見てください。通行止めの間、14番バスはレイク通りの仮停留所に停車し、ピーク時には20分おきに運行します。

歩行者と自転車は、橋の北側にある仮の歩道を使って川を渡ることができます。歩道は狭いので注意してください。子どもには必ず大人が付き添ってください。閉鎖された車道を歩いてはいけません。自転車は降りて、押して歩道を渡ってください。

天候に問題がなければ、橋は12月6日に再開する予定です。通行止めの最初の週は、迂回路の各交差点に新しい案内標識を設置します。通行止めによるご不便をお詫びするとともに、住民の皆さまのご理解に感謝いたします。

最新情報は www.harrowcity.gov/transport をご覧いただくか、555-0139 までお電話ください。

title: Article: Tidal turbines pilot in Port Halden
passage:
PORT HALDEN — The harbor town of Port Halden has begun testing its first tidal turbines, underwater devices that generate electricity from the movement of ocean currents. — [1] — The two turbines, each about the size of a school bus, were installed last month at the mouth of the bay. Each turbine rests on a steel frame anchored to the seabed, and its blades are designed to turn slowly in the water. Engineers spent several months surveying the seabed before the equipment was lowered into place.

The project is a joint effort between the town council and Northwind Power, a regional energy firm. Council member Ruth Callahan said the turbines could supply up to 15 percent of the electricity used by local homes and businesses. — [2] — Currents in the bay are strong and predictable, which engineers say makes the site well suited to this technology. — [3] — Several local businesses have also asked whether they can buy power directly from the project once it is fully operating.

Environmental concerns were raised during the planning stage. Fishing crews worried that the equipment might tangle their nets and reduce their catches. Northwind has since moved the turbines farther from the main fishing lanes and agreed to share sensor data with local boat operators. — [4] — The company also agreed to hold a public meeting before the next phase begins, so that residents can ask questions about the project directly. Local fishing associations will receive a copy of the monthly sensor report, and their members may attend the meeting.

The pilot will run for eighteen months. If the results are positive, the council will consider adding more turbines in the next phase of the project. Engineers will record the turbines' output every hour and compare it with data from the council's weather station. Residents can follow the test results on the town's website, which will be updated each month. The council has also set aside a small fund to repair any damage to fish habitats caused by the project.
translation:
ポートハルデン発 ― 港町ポートハルデンは、初めての潮流タービンの試験を始めた。潮流タービンは、海流の動きから電気を生み出す水中の装置である。2基のタービンはそれぞれスクールバスほどの大きさで、先月、湾の入口に設置された。各タービンは海底に固定された鋼鉄製の枠の上に載っており、羽根は水の中でゆっくり回転するように設計されている。ノースウィンドの技術者は、機材を据え付ける前に数か月かけて海底を調査した。

この事業は、町議会と地域のエネルギー企業ノースウィンド・パワーの共同事業である。議員のルース・キャラハン氏は、タービンが地元の家庭と事業所で使われる電力の最大15%をまかなえる可能性があると述べた。この海域の海流は強く予測しやすく、技術者はこの技術に適した場所だと考えている。地元の企業からも、事業が本格的に稼働したら電力を直接買えないか、という問い合わせが寄せられている。

計画段階では環境への懸念も出た。漁船の乗組員は、機材が網に絡まって漁獲が減るのではないかと心配した。その後、ノースウィンドはタービンを主要な漁場からさらに離して設置し、地元の船の運航者とセンサーのデータを共有することに同意した。同社はさらに、次の段階が始まる前に住民向けの説明会を開き、事業について直接質問できる場を設けることにも同意した。地元の漁業団体は、毎月のセンサー報告書の写しを受け取り、会員は説明会に出席できる。

試験は18か月間行われる。結果が良ければ、議会は次の段階でタービンを増やすことを検討する。技術者は、タービンの発電量を1時間ごとに記録し、町の気象観測所のデータと比べる。住民は町のウェブサイトで試験結果を確認でき、結果は毎月更新される。議会は、事業によって魚の生息地に損害が出た場合に備えて、修復のための小さな基金も確保している。

title: Email: Amended grant disbursement schedule
passage:
From: Dr. Helen Osei <hosei@brookfieldbio.edu>
To: Cellular Genomics Research Team
Date: September 14
Subject: Amended grant disbursement

Dear colleagues,

The Hartmann Foundation has informed me that our grant will now be disbursed in two installments rather than the three originally stipulated. The first installment, which covers expenses through December, has already been approved and is scheduled for October 1. The second installment, however, is contingent upon our submission of an interim progress report that demonstrates measurable results from the sequencing phase. The report should include a summary of the sample preparation, the quality scores for each batch, and a brief comparison with the results of last year's pilot study. Because a late report would be reviewed only at the discretion of the foundation's board, I would like to finalize the draft report by October 20 rather than November 3, as we had discussed.

Please note that equipment purchases made before the first installment arrives cannot be reimbursed retroactively. Kindly postpone any orders until I confirm that the funds have cleared. Our lab manager, Peter Quist, will keep a record of all receipts and forward them to the finance office each week. Dr. Tomasz Lindqvist will coordinate the statistical analysis, so please direct any data questions to him. Dr. Anna Berglund, the foundation's program officer, has confirmed that the schedule change applies to all active grants in this cycle.

I have also attached the revised budget table. Please check the line items for your project and let me know by September 25 if any figures need correction. The foundation has asked us to confirm that all team members have completed the required safety training, so if you have not yet done so, please contact the training office this week. Thank you for your hard work this year. I know the new schedule is demanding, and I appreciate your flexibility. If you need to travel for conferences this autumn, please let me know early so that we can plan the budget accordingly. Please also update your timesheets before the end of the month.

Regards,
Helen Osei
translation:
差出人:ヘレン・オセイ博士 / 宛先:細胞ゲノム研究チーム / 9月14日 / 件名:助成金の支払い変更

皆さんへ

ハートマン財団から連絡があり、当研究室の助成金は当初定められていた3回ではなく、2回に分けて支払われることになりました。12月までの経費を対象とする第1回分はすでに承認されており、10月1日に支払われる予定です。一方、第2回分は、塩基配列解析の段階で測定可能な成果を示す中間進捗報告書の提出が条件です。報告書には、試料の準備の概要、各バッチの品質スコア、昨年度のパイロット研究の結果との簡単な比較を含めてください。提出が遅れた報告書は財団の理事会の裁量でのみ審査されるため、話し合ったとおり11月3日ではなく10月20日までに報告書の草稿を仕上げたいと考えています。

ご注意ください。第1回分の入金前に購入した機材は、さかのぼって経費として認められません。資金が入ったことを私が確認するまで、注文は控えてください。ラボ責任者のピーター・クイストが、すべての領収書を記録し、毎週経理課に回します。トマシュ・リンドクヴィスト博士が統計解析を取りまとめるので、データに関する質問は彼に直接お問い合わせください。財団のプログラム担当者であるアンナ・ベルグルンド博士は、今回の支払い変更が今期のすべての進行中の助成金に適用されると確認している。

私が添付した修正版の予算表もご確認ください。担当するプロジェクトの項目を確認し、数字の修正が必要な場合は9月25日までに知らせてください。財団から、チーム全員が必要な安全研修を修了したことを確認するよう求められています。まだの方は、今週中に研修事務局へ連絡してください。今年も皆さんの努力に感謝します。新しいスケジュールは負担が大きいと思いますが、柔軟に対応してくださっていることにありがとうと伝えたいです。今秋に学会出張が必要な方は、予算を組めるように早めに知らせてください。月末までに勤務時間の記録も更新してください。

ヘレン・オセイ

title: Triple passage: Tour listing, booking confirmation, and online review
passage:
【Document 1: Tour listing】
Ridgeback Guided Hikes — Autumn Schedule
Lakeview Loop (8 km, moderate): 3 hours, departs 9:00 A.M. — $45 per person
Stone Canyon Ascent (12 km, strenuous): 5 hours, departs 8:00 A.M. — $70 per person
Forest Meadow Walk (4 km, easy): 2 hours, departs 10:30 A.M. — $25 per person
Children under 12 receive 50 percent off any tour. Each tour requires at least four participants; if fewer register, the tour is moved to the following Saturday. Lunch is not included, and hiking boots are recommended.
Every guided tour is led by a certified guide with first-aid training. Groups are limited to twelve people, and guides adjust the pace to suit the slowest hiker in the group. Water bottles are included with every booking, and restrooms are available at the trailhead for all three routes. The Stone Canyon Ascent includes a steep section near the summit, so hikers should have a reasonable level of fitness before they book. Guides check the weather each morning, and guests will be notified by phone if a route must be changed for safety reasons. Gift vouchers can be purchased online and are valid for twelve months from the date of purchase.

【Document 2: Booking confirmation】
Booking #RG-6042
Name: Sophie Lindgren
Tour: Stone Canyon Ascent, October 18
Participants: 2 adults, 1 child (age 9)
Meeting point: Ridgeback office, 14 Pine Road, 7:30 A.M.
Note: Our guide will confirm the tour by phone the evening before. If the tour is canceled, you will receive a full refund. Payment was charged to the credit card on file on October 1, and a receipt has been sent to the e-mail address provided. Please bring a printed copy of this confirmation or show it on your phone at the meeting point. Changes to the number of participants must be reported at least three days before the tour date. For questions, please contact the office at 555-0172 during business hours. Guests with dietary restrictions should mention them when booking so that the guide can plan water and snack stops. Parking is available behind the Ridgeback office for guests who arrive by car. Please arrive at least fifteen minutes before departure to complete the check-in form. Our office is closed on public holidays, so please call on another day if you need help.

【Document 3: Online review】
Posted by Sophie Lindgren, October 19
Our group had an excellent time on the Stone Canyon Ascent. The views from the summit were spectacular, and our guide, Marco, pointed out local plants along the way. The trail was steeper than I expected, though, and my daughter needed several breaks. Please note that lunch is not provided, so pack plenty of food. Marco also shared stories about the history of the canyon, which made the long walk more interesting. The weather was perfect, and the trail was well marked for the whole route. Booking was simple, and the confirmation e-mail arrived within an hour. The staff at the office were friendly and answered my questions about the route before the tour started. Our daughter enjoyed collecting leaves for a school project, and the guide gave her a small notebook to record the plant names. Overall, I would recommend this company to anyone who enjoys hiking. Next time we will try the Forest Meadow Walk, which seems more suitable for younger children.

【文書1:ツアー一覧】リッジバック・ガイドツアー 秋の日程/レイクビュー・ループ(8km、中級):3時間、午前9時出発、1人45ドル/ストーン・キャニオン登山(12km、きつい):5時間、午前8時出発、1人70ドル/フォレスト・メドウ散歩(4km、易しい):2時間、午前10時30分出発、1人25ドル/12歳未満の子どもは全ツアー50%引き。どのツアーも最少4名から催行し、催行人数に満たない場合は翌週の土曜日に延期する。昼食は含まれない。登山靴の着用を推奨。
全てのガイド付きツアーは、応急手当の資格を持つ認定ガイドが案内する。1グループは12名までで、ガイドはグループの中で最も遅い人に合わせて歩く速度を調整する。どの予約にも水筒が含まれ、3つのコースすべての登山口にトイレがある。ストーン・キャニオン登山には山頂付近に急な区間があるため、予約する前にある程度の体力が必要。ガイドは毎朝天候を確認し、安全上の理由でコースを変更する必要がある場合は電話で連絡する。ギフト券はオンラインで購入でき、購入日から12か月間有効。

【文書2:予約確認書】予約番号RG-6042/氏名:ソフィー・リンドグレン/ツアー:ストーン・キャニオン登山、10月18日/参加者:大人2名、子ども1名(9歳)/集合場所:リッジバック事務所(パイン通り14番地)午前7時30分/注:前日の夜にガイドから電話で確認する。ツアーが中止になった場合は全額返金する。代金は10月1日に登録されたクレジットカードから引き落とされ、領収書は登録のメールアドレスに送付済み。この確認書の印刷物を持参するか、集合場所で携帯電話に表示して提示する。参加人数を変更する場合は、ツアー日の少なくとも3日前までに連絡する。質問は営業時間内に555-0172の事務所まで。食事制限のある方は予約時に伝えてください。ガイドが水分補給や軽食の休憩を計画できるようにするためです。車で来るお客様のために、リッジバック事務所の裏に駐車場があります。出発の15分前までに到着し、受付票に記入してください。事務所は祝日休業です。ほかの日に電話してください。

【文書3:オンラインレビュー】ソフィー・リンドグレン 10月19日投稿/ストーン・キャニオン登山は素晴らしい体験だった。山頂からの眺めは見事で、ガイドのマルコが道中の地元の植物を教えてくれた。ただ、道は思ったより急で、娘は何度も休憩が必要だった。昼食は出ないので、食べ物をたくさん持参してほしい。マルコはキャニオンの歴史の話も聞かせてくれて、長い道のりがさらに面白くなった。天気は完璧で、コース全体にわかりやすく道標があった。予約は簡単で、確認メールは1時間以内に届いた。事務所のスタッフは親切で、ツアーが始まる前にコースについての質問に答えてくれた。娘は学校の課題のために葉っぱを集め、ガイドが植物の名前を記録する小さなノートをくれた。登山が好きな人には全体的におすすめしたい。次回は森と草原の散歩に挑戦する予定だ。子ども向けにより向いていそうだから。

title: Triple passage: Printing quotation, vendor chart, and e-mail

Crestline Print Works — Quotation No. 774

Unit price: $0.86 per copy. The $150 setup fee is waived for orders of more than 4,000 copies.

Artwork must be submitted as a print-ready PDF. Design changes after approval cost $75 per revision.
Colors are matched to the client's brand guide using a press proof, which is sent for approval before the full run begins. Shipping to the client's office is included in the quoted price. This quotation is valid for thirty days from the date of issue, and production begins once the signed approval form is received. Cartons are labeled with the client's order number to help the receiving team sort the brochures quickly. Each carton holds 250 brochures, and the vendor issues a tracking number so the client can follow the delivery. Paper samples are available on request at no charge, and the vendor will confirm the exact delivery date in writing.

【Document 2: Vendor comparison chart】
Vendor | Total for 5,000 copies | Standard turnaround | Recycled stock
Crestline Print Works | $4,300 | 7–10 business days | Not available
Bluebird Press | $4,650 | 5 business days | Available
Maple Graphics | $4,250 (includes $150 setup fee) | 10 business days | Available
Note: Recycled stock is available at no extra charge from the vendors that offer it. All totals are in U.S. dollars and exclude sales tax. Turnaround times begin once the artwork has been approved. Recycled stock is certified by an independent environmental group, and the certificate is included with each order. The vendors were compared using the same paper weight, color settings, and finishing options.

【Document 3: E-mail】
From: Lena Ortega
To: Marketing Team
Date: March 4
Subject: Brochure printing

Team,
The brochures for our March 20 product launch must reach the venue by March 15. Our printing budget is $4,700, and company policy requires that all printed materials use recycled paper. The brochures will be handed out to guests at the entrance, so the design was finalized last week and we will not make further changes. I have reviewed the three quotes. Crestline's standard price is reasonable, but its paper is not recycled, so I have ruled it out. Maple Graphics is the least expensive of the three, but its standard turnaround of ten business days is too long for our schedule. Please place the order with the vendor that meets both requirements. Once the order is placed, please send the print-ready PDF to the vendor the same day, and copy me on the confirmation so I can file it with the launch documents. The launch team has asked to see a printed proof before the full run, so please make sure the vendor sends one. I will confirm the number of guests with the events office by March 8. Please let me know right away if the vendor's delivery schedule changes, since our launch date cannot move.

Thanks,
Lena

title: Double passage: Food handler certificate notice and e-mail
passage:
【Document 1: Notice】
Lakeshore County Health Department — Food Handler Certificate Renewal
All food service workers must renew their food handler certificates every three years. Renewal requires completing a two-hour online course and passing a 40-question exam with a score of at least 80 percent. Candidates who fail may retake the exam seven days after the failed attempt. Until they pass, they may not handle unpackaged food. The renewal fee is $35 and must be paid online. Certificates may be renewed up to 60 days before their expiration date. Certificate holders must carry a copy of their certificate during working hours and show it to inspectors on request. The online course covers safe storage temperatures, hand washing, cross-contamination, and cleaning procedures. Questions about course content can be sent to the health department's education office during business hours, and staff will reply within three working days. Employers must keep a record of each worker's certificate status and allow time during working hours for the online course. Workers who hold a certificate issued by another county must register it with the health department before starting work here. Renewal reminders are sent by e-mail sixty days before expiration, but workers are responsible for renewing on time. Renewal forms are available on the department's website, and paper forms are not accepted.

【Document 2: E-mail】
From: Javier Morales
To: Certification Desk
Date: October 22
Subject: Certificate renewal

Hello,
My food handler certificate expires on November 15, and I work as a cook at Riverside Grill. I completed the online course on October 10, but I failed the exam on October 18 with a score of 76 percent. Could I retake it before November 1? I am scheduled to work a holiday shift on November 20, and I need a valid certificate for that. I have been a cook for six years and have always renewed on time before. This time I was busy planning the holiday menu and did not realize how close the deadline was. I checked the health department website on October 21, and it confirms that the fee must be paid online. I will keep my old certificate and a copy of my identification ready in case you need them for the record. Please let me know if there is anything else I should prepare before the exam. My manager has also offered to cover the renewal fee if I send her a receipt. Is that arrangement allowed? I would also like to know whether I can take the exam in the morning, since my evening shifts make it hard to study. My colleagues have been very supportive and have offered to share their notes from the course.

Thank you,
Javier Morales
translation:
【文書1:お知らせ】レイクショア郡保健局 食品取扱者証の更新/すべての飲食業の従業員は、3年ごとに食品取扱者証を更新しなければならない。更新には2時間のオンライン講座の修了と、40問の試験で80%以上の得点が必要。不合格者は、不合格の日から7日後に再受験できる。合格するまで、包装されていない食品を扱うことはできない。更新料は35ドルで、オンラインでのみ支払える。証明書の有効期限の60日前から更新できる。証明書を持つ人は、勤務中は証明書の写しを携帯し、検査官から求められたら提示しなければならない。オンライン講座では、安全な保管温度、手洗い、交差汚染、清掃の手順を学ぶ。講座の内容に関する質問は、営業時間内に保健局の教育担当課へ送ることができ、担当者は3営業日以内に返信する。雇用主は、各従業員の証明書の状況を記録し、オンライン講座を受けるための時間を勤務時間内に与えなければならない。別の郡で発行された証明書を持つ人は、ここで働く前に保健局に登録しなければならない。更新の案内は有効期限の60日前にメールで送られるが、期限内に更新する責任は従業員にある。更新用紙は保健局のウェブサイトから入手でき、紙の用紙は受け付けない。

【文書2:メール】差出人:ハビアー・モラレス/宛先:認定窓口/10月22日/件名:証明書の更新/こんにちは。私の食品取扱者証は11月15日に期限が切れます。リバーサイド・グリルで調理人として働いています。10月10日にオンライン講座を修了しましたが、10月18日の試験は76%で不合格でした。11月1日より前に再受験できますか。11月20日に祝日のシフトに入る予定で、そのためには有効な証明書が必要です。私はこの仕事を6年続けており、これまでは期限内に更新してきました。今回は祝日のメニュー作りで忙しく、期限が近いことに気づきませんでした。10月21日に保健局のウェブサイトを確認したところ、更新料はオンラインでのみ支払うことになっていました。古い証明書と身分証明書のコピーを、記録のために必要になった場合に備えて用意しておきます。試験前に準備すべきことがほかにあれば教えてください。店長が、領収書を送れば更新料を負担すると申し出てくれています。この取り決めは認められますか。夜のシフトが多く勉強しにくいので、試験を午前中に受けられるかも知りたいです。同僚たちもとても協力的で、講座のノートを共有すると申し出てくれています。よろしくお願いします。ハビアー・モラレス

title: Advertisement: Pet grooming salon opening
passage:
Pawsitive Grooming Opens on Birch Road!

Is your dog overdue for a bath? Our experienced groomers treat every animal with patience and care. Each member of our team has completed a certified grooming course and has at least three years of hands-on experience. We welcome all breeds, from tiny terriers to large retrievers. Many customers tell us that their dogs are calmer after their first visit. Our salon is located in the former post office building on Birch Road, and its quiet grooming rooms are separated from the reception area, so nervous pets can relax away from the noise of the street.

Services
• Bath and blow-dry: $35 for small dogs, $50 for large dogs
• Full haircut: $60 and up, depending on coat type
• Nail trimming and ear cleaning: $15, available with any service

All tools are sterilized after every appointment, and the bathing area is cleaned with pet-safe products. Payment can be made by cash, credit card, or mobile payment.

Opening special: Book any service during our first two weeks and receive a free brushing session for your pet. Appointments are recommended, and we suggest booking at least three days in advance. Our staff will also explain how to keep your pet's coat healthy between visits, and this advice is included with every service. Puppies are welcome to visit the salon with their owners to get used to the dryers and clippers before their first full appointment. We also welcome walk-in customers on Saturdays, but only for nail trimming.

Call 555-0139 or visit our website to make a reservation. Free parking is available behind the building, and the salon is a five-minute walk from the Birch Road bus stop. If you need to cancel, please call us at least 24 hours before your appointment. We are open Tuesday through Saturday, 9:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M. We look forward to meeting you and your furry friends, and we hope to become your neighborhood's favorite grooming salon.

title: Article: Hometown newspaper drops its print edition
passage:
Harbor Ledger to Go Digital-Only

Harbor City residents who read the local paper over breakfast will soon need to change their habits. Many longtime readers have written to the newsroom to say how much they will miss the printed edition. After 112 years of daily printing, the Harbor Ledger will publish its last paper edition on December 31. — [1] — The newspaper's publisher, Greg Halloway, said the decision was difficult but necessary, because printing costs have risen sharply and advertising revenue has continued to fall. Paper and ink prices have roughly doubled since 2020, and delivery trucks now cost far more to run on the longer routes that serve the outlying towns. Several large local retailers have also moved their advertising to social media, which has made it harder for the paper to cover its costs. — [2] — Subscribers will receive a full digital edition, which will be updated throughout the day rather than once each morning. The digital edition will include the same photographs, obituaries, and local event listings that readers see in print today. — [3] — Readers without internet access can still read a printed copy of the paper at the public library. — [4] —

Mr. Halloway added that the newsroom will not shrink. In fact, the paper plans to hire two more reporters to cover the city council and local schools. Both positions are expected to be filled by the end of January, and the new reporters will be based in the paper's downtown office. Print subscribers will receive a 40 percent discount on their first year of digital access, and anyone who wishes to cancel may do so before the end of the year without penalty. Mr. Halloway said the staff would welcome feedback from readers during the transition. He also invited residents to visit the newsroom on the last Saturday of December to see the final printing presses before they are removed. The paper's archive, which dates back more than a century, will remain available to subscribers online.
translation:
ハーバー・レジャー紙、デジタル版のみに

ハーバー市で朝食の時間に地元紙を読んでいる人たちは、まもなく習慣を変える必要がありそうです。長年の読者の多くが、紙面版がなくなることを惜しむ手紙を編集局に寄せています。112年間、毎日紙で発行してきたハーバー・レジャー紙は、12月31日に最後の紙面版を発行する。発行人のグレッグ・ハロウェイは、印刷費が大幅に上がり、広告収入も減り続けているため、難しいが必要な決断だったと述べた。2020年以降、紙とインクの価格はおよそ2倍になり、郊外の町へ届ける配送トラックも、遠回りになったため運行費が大きく増えている。地元の大手小売店も広告をソーシャルメディアへ移しており、紙面の経費をまかなうことがさらに難しくなっている。購読者には完全なデジタル版が届き、朝の1回ではなく一日を通して更新される。デジタル版には、現在紙面で読まれている写真、訃報、地域の催し物情報と同じものが掲載される。インターネットを使えない読者は、公立図書館で紙面を読むことができる。

ハロウェイ氏は、編集局は縮小しないと付け加えた。実際、市議会と地元の学校を取材するため、記者を2人増員する計画だ。両方のポストは1月末までに埋まる見込みで、新しい記者は市の中心部にある紙の本社オフィスに所属する。紙の購読者は、デジタル版を利用する最初の1年間が40%引きになる。年末までに解約を希望する人は、違約金なしで解約できる。ハロウェイ氏は、移行期間中は読者からの意見を歓迎すると述べた。また、12月の最後の土曜日に編集局を一般公開し、撤去される前の最後の印刷機を見学できるようにするとも呼びかけた。100年以上のバックナンバーは、引き続き購読者がオンラインで閲覧できる。

title: Email: Mentorship program for new hires
passage:
From: Lydia Cho, Human Resources
To: Ben Tanaka
Date: September 14
Subject: Welcome to the mentorship program

Dear Ben,

Welcome to Cedar Point Logistics! We are pleased to tell you that you have been matched with a mentor for your first six months. Your mentor is Sofia Alvarez, who has worked in our customer accounts department for nine years. Ms. Alvarez is known for her clear feedback and her patience with new staff. We hope this program will help you settle into your role quickly and build relationships across departments. You will meet with her once every two weeks, either in person or by video call. Ms. Alvarez has also agreed to introduce you to colleagues in the sales and shipping teams, so that you will know who to contact for questions about company procedures.

Each session lasts 45 minutes. Ms. Alvarez has asked you to bring a list of questions or current projects to each meeting so that the time can be used well. Sessions are informal, so there is no need to prepare a formal presentation. Many new employees find that regular conversations with a mentor help them understand how the company's departments work together, so we encourage you to be open about your goals. Mentors and mentees are also encouraged to set one goal for the first three months. The first meeting is scheduled for Thursday, September 19, at 2:00 P.M. in Conference Room C, which is on the third floor next to the elevators. Please arrive on time, since the room is booked for the rest of that week.

If you cannot attend a session, please inform Ms. Alvarez at least one day in advance, and also let Human Resources know so that the schedule can be updated. Participants who complete the program will receive a certificate and a $200 allowance for professional development courses. The certificate will be issued by Human Resources at the end of the program, and the allowance can be used for courses approved by your manager.

If you have any questions before your first meeting, please contact me at extension 417.

Best regards,
Lydia Cho
translation:
送信者:人事部のリディア・チョ
宛先:ベン・タナカ
日付:9月14日
件名:メンター制度へようこそ

ベンさま

シーダー・ポイント物流へようこそ!あなたの最初の6か月のメンターが決まりましたので、お知らせします。メンターはソフィア・アルバレスさんで、当社の顧客口座部門で9年間働いています。アルバレスさんは、的確なフィードバックと新入社員への根気強い指導で知られています。このプログラムが、あなたが早く業務に慣れ、部署をまたいで人間関係を築く助けになることを願っています。2週間に1回、対面かビデオ通話でお会いいただきます。アルバレスさんは、営業部と出荷部の同僚も紹介してくださることになりました。社内の手続きについて質問があるときに、誰に聞けばよいかが分かるようにするためです。

1回の面談は45分です。限られた時間を有効に使えるよう、アルバレスさんからは毎回、質問リストか進行中の仕事を持参するよう依頼がありました。面談は堅苦しいものではないので、正式な発表資料を準備する必要はありません。メンターと定期的に話すことで、会社の各部署がどう連携しているかを理解しやすくなる新入社員は多くいます。そのため、目標についても率直に話してください。また、メンターと一緒に最初の3か月の目標を一つ決めることをおすすめします。初回は9月19日(木)午後2時、会議室Cで予定しています。会議室Cは3階のエレベーターの隣にあります。その週は会議室が予約済みなので、時間どおりにお越しください。

出席できない場合は、少なくとも1日前にアルバレスさんへご連絡ください。あわせて人事部にも知らせて、予定を更新できるようにしてください。プログラムを修了した方には、修了証と専門能力開発講座のための200ドルの手当が支給されます。修了証はプログラム終了時に人事部から発行され、手当は上司が承認した講座に使えます。

初回の面談の前に質問があれば、内線417の私までご連絡ください。

よろしくお願いいたします。
リディア・チョ

title: Triple passage: Mobile phone plans, e-mail, and customer reply
passage:
【Document 1: Plan chart】
Fernway Mobile: Monthly Plans (tax not included)
Basic 5GB: $25 per month, unlimited calls within the country
Plus 20GB: $40 per month, includes 500 minutes of international calls
Max 60GB: $58 per month, includes high-definition streaming
Overage charge: Data used beyond your plan's limit is billed at $5 per additional gigabyte, up to a maximum of $20 per month.
Roaming: Data used abroad is charged at $10 per gigabyte, regardless of plan. A Travel Pass costs $15 per week and includes up to 10 gigabytes abroad at no additional charge.
Plan changes: You may change your plan at any time through the app, and the new plan takes effect at the start of your next billing cycle.
Usage alerts: We send a text message when you have used 80 percent of your data allowance.
Travel Pass: Passes can be purchased through the app or at any store, and they start on the day of purchase.
Network coverage: Our network covers more than 95 percent of the population, including most rural areas.
Customer support: Our support team is available by phone and e-mail from 8:00 A.M. to 10:00 P.M. every day.

【Document 2: E-mail】
From: Hana Okada
To: support@fernwaymobile.com
Date: April 9
Subject: Unexpected charge

Hello,
I have been a customer for six years and usually check my bill carefully, so this charge surprised me. I am on the Plus 20GB plan. Last month I used about 23 gigabytes at home, so I expected an overage charge of about $15. However, my bill came to $35 in total. I also spent six days in Canada on a business trip, where I used about two gigabytes. I did not buy a Travel Pass because I assumed my plan would cover data abroad. My trip was for a client meeting, and my company does not reimburse unexpected phone charges, so I need this resolved quickly. I would like to know why the extra $20 was charged. My account number is listed on my last bill, and I can send a copy if needed.

Thank you,
Hana Okada

【Document 3: Reply】
From: Fernway Customer Support
To: Hana Okada
Date: April 11
Subject: RE: Unexpected charge

Dear Ms. Okada,
Thank you for contacting us. We understand that unexpected charges can be frustrating, and we appreciate your patience. We have reviewed your account. Your overage charge of $15 is correct, since you exceeded your plan's 20-gigabyte limit by three gigabytes. Your data use in Canada, however, was billed at the roaming rate of $10 per gigabyte, which is why the second charge is $20. Because this was your first trip abroad with us, we will refund half of the roaming charge. The refund will appear on your next statement. Your Plus 20GB plan itself remains the same. In the future, you may wish to buy a Travel Pass before you travel. It would have cost you $15 and covered the data you used. We have also updated our roaming information page so that customers can check current rates before they travel. We appreciate your loyalty and look forward to serving you for many years to come.

Sincerely,

title: Triple passage: Visitor policy notice, family e-mail, and nurse's reply
passage:
【Document 1: Notice】
Lakeview Memorial Hospital: Visitor Policy Update
Effective October 1
The new rules were developed by the hospital's infection control team to protect patients who are recovering from surgery.
• Surgical ward: Patients may receive up to two visitors at a time, between 10:00 A.M. and 8:00 P.M. Visitors must be at least 12 years old and must wear a visitor badge at all times. Badges are available at the front desk on the ground floor. Staff may ask visitors to step out of the room during medical procedures or when a patient needs to rest.
• Intensive care unit: Visits are limited to 15 minutes per hour, and only immediate family members are permitted. Children under 12 may not visit. Visitors must wash their hands before entering and after leaving the unit.
• Visitors with a cold, fever, or cough should postpone their visit. Visitors who are unsure whether they are well enough to visit should call the ward before coming. Hand sanitizer is available at every entrance.
• Parking: The main parking garage is open 24 hours a day, and visitors may park there for up to four hours.
• Visitor lounge: A quiet lounge is available on the second floor for families who need a short break.

【Document 2: E-mail】
From: Marisol Reyes
To: Patient Services
Date: October 4
Subject: Visiting my father

Hello,
My father is recovering in the surgical ward after his knee operation. The surgery went well, and the doctors expect him to go home within two weeks, but he still gets tired easily. I would like to visit him with my two children, who are nine and eleven years old. They have been asking to see their grandfather every day since his operation. Would they be allowed to come up to the ward? My brother also plans to join me. He lives two hours away and is taking the day off work to come with us. Because my shift ends at 7:30 P.M., I can only arrive around 7:45, so I hope the staff can let us stay a little longer than 8:00 P.M. We understand if this is not possible, and we will follow whatever the ward decides.

I appreciate your help with this.

Thank you,
Marisol Reyes

【Document 3: Reply】
From: Helen Ward, Nurse Manager, Surgical Ward
To: Marisol Reyes
Date: October 5
Subject: RE: Visiting my father

Dear Ms. Reyes,
Thank you for your message. We are glad to hear that your father is making good progress after his operation. Unfortunately, children under 12 are not permitted in the surgical ward, so your children will need to wait until your father is discharged. In the meantime, you are welcome to send them a drawing or a card through the front desk, and the nurses will pass it on to him. You and your brother are welcome to visit together, since two visitors are allowed at one time. Please remember that both of you must wear badges and sign in at the front desk before going up. We are unable to extend visiting hours past 8:00 P.M., but please arrive by 7:45 P.M. so that you have time to collect your visitor badges at the front desk. If the front desk is busy when you arrive, our staff will help you as quickly as possible. Please call the ward directly if your plans change, and we will do our best to help.

Best regards,
Helen Ward

【文書1:お知らせ】レイクビュー記念病院:面会規則の変更(10月1日から)/新しい規則は、手術後の回復中の患者を守るため、病院の感染管理チームが作成しました。/外科病棟:患者1人につき、午前10時から午後8時まで、同時に2人まで面会可。面会者は12歳以上で、常に面会バッジを着用すること。バッジは1階の受付で受け取れる。スタッフは、処置中や患者が休息を必要とするときに、面会者に部屋の外へ出てもらうことがある。/集中治療室:面会は1時間に15分まで、直系の家族のみ。12歳未満の子どもは面会不可。面会者は、病棟に入る前と出た後に手を洗うこと。/風邪・発熱・せきのある人は面会を延期すること。面会できる体調か迷う人は、来院前に病棟へ電話すること。消毒液は各入口に置いてある。/駐車:院内の主要な駐車場は終日利用でき、面会者は最長4時間まで駐車できる。/面会者ラウンジ:2階に静かなラウンジがあり、疲れた家族が少し休憩できる。

【文書2:メール】送信者:マリソル・レイエス/宛先:患者サービス窓口/10月4日/件名:父の面会について/父は膝の手術後、外科病棟で回復中です。手術は順調で、医師からは2週間以内の退院が見込まれると言われましたが、まだすぐに疲れてしまいます。9歳と11歳の子ども2人を連れて面会したいのですが、病棟に上がれますか。子どもたちは、手術後ずっと毎日、祖父に会いたいと言っています。兄も一緒に来る予定です。兄は2時間離れた所に住んでおり、仕事を休んで同行してくれます。仕事は午後7時30分に終わるので、到着は7時45分ごろになります。午後8時を過ぎても少し滞在させてもらえないか、ご相談させてください。難しい場合は、病棟の判断に従います。ご対応いただき感謝しております。よろしくお願いいたします。マリソル・レイエス

【文書3:返信】送信者:ヘレン・ウォード(外科病棟看護師長)/宛先:マリソル・レイエス/10月5日/件名:RE:父の面会について/レイエス様/ご連絡ありがとうございます。お父さまが手術後順調に回復されていると伺い、安心いたしました。あいにく12歳未満の子どもは外科病棟に入れないため、お子さんは、お父さまが退院されるまでお待ちください。その間、受付を通じてお子さんが描いた絵やカードをお送りいただければ、看護師が父上にお渡しします。同時に2人まで面会できるため、あなたとお兄様は一緒に面会いただけます。ただし、二人とも面会バッジを着用し、上がる前に受付で記帳していただく必要があります。面会時間の午後8時以降の延長はできません。ただし、受付でバッジを受け取る時間を考えて、午後7時45分までにはお越しください。到着時に受付が混み合っている場合は、スタッフができるだけ早く対応します。ご予定が変わる場合は病棟へ直接お電話ください。できる限りお手伝いいたします。

title: Triple passage: Wedding package list, client e-mail, and reply
passage:
【Document 1: Package list】
Clearwater Photography: Wedding Packages
Essential: 4 hours of coverage, 200 edited photos — $1,400
Premier: 6 hours of coverage, 400 edited photos, and one album — $2,000
Signature: Coverage of up to 10 hours, 600 edited photos, two albums, and a drone shot — $2,900
Additional hour of coverage: $180 (Essential and Premier packages only)
A 30 percent deposit is required to hold a date and is non-refundable. The remaining balance is due 30 days before the event. All packages include a private online gallery where couples can view and download their photos for one year. Our photographers arrive at least 30 minutes before the ceremony to set up equipment and check the lighting. Engagement sessions are not included in any package but can be booked separately. Travel within 50 miles of our studio is included; beyond that, mileage charges apply. Once a booking is confirmed, the wedding date cannot be changed without the approval of the studio manager.

【Document 2: E-mail】
From: Felicia Grant
To: bookings@clearwaterphoto.com
Date: March 2
Subject: Our wedding on September 13

Hello,
We are so excited about our wedding and have been planning it for over a year. We booked the Premier package last June and paid the deposit at that time. Our ceremony now begins at 11:00 A.M., and the reception ends at 7:00 P.M., so the day will last about eight hours instead of six. The extra time is needed for the family photos and the first dance, which we would like to capture properly. We would like to add two hours of coverage to our package. Our guests have traveled from several countries, so we want every moment of the day to be recorded. Our families are very involved in the planning, and everyone is looking forward to the day. We are also thinking about a drone shot, which our friends have recommended. Would it be possible to switch to the Signature package instead? My mother has offered to help us plan the timeline for the photos. Please let us know the total cost so that we can plan our budget.

Thank you,
Felicia Grant

【Document 3: Reply】
From: Clearwater Bookings
To: Felicia Grant
Date: March 4
Subject: RE: Our wedding on September 13

Dear Ms. Grant,
Thank you for your message. We are delighted to hear about your wedding and are happy to help make the day special. We are holding September 13 for you, and your deposit is on record. Two additional hours can be added to the Premier package at the standard hourly rate. Please note that the extra hours will be billed at the same rate for both the ceremony and the reception. Switching to the Signature package is also possible, and it includes the drone shot. Our drone pilot is licensed and will need to confirm the weather on the wedding day. Please let us know your decision by the end of this month so that we can update your contract. Once we receive your decision, we will send you a revised summary of the package and the payment schedule. If you would like to review the timeline together, our planning team is available for a short call next week. Thank you for choosing Clearwater.

Sincerely,
Clearwater Bookings
